advisory.finding: `rebar edit <id> --review` (and any edit invocation that sets no fields and no tags) emits a false confirmation `edited <id>: ` (empty field list, dangling colon) even though edit_core writes no EDIT event — the confirmation is emitted unconditionally at composer.py:667 before the --review branch and does not check whether anything actually changed.

advisory.suggested_fix: Emit the confirmation only when `set_names` is non-empty (or when edit_core reports it wrote something); otherwise emit a no-op/skip. Move the emit after the change-detection so an empty edit does not report `edited`.
